Level 3 - Intermediate 105 min Build it yourself: 90 min Machine-coding case study Patterns: Specification, Strategy, Builder, Facade

Rental Search & In-Memory Search Engine (NoBroker)

Two interview favourites that are really one design: Flipkart's "Property Hunt" (find homes by location, price, size, BHK; sort; shortlist; mark sold) and Razorpay's "in-memory search engine" (add and delete documents, AND search, order by frequency or date). You get an inverted index you can delete from correctly, filters as composable Specifications, ranking as a Strategy, stable pagination, a read-write lock that keeps three indexes consistent, and running Java, Python and C++14 code.
